liquidbounce.command.findings.descriptio: Manages what BaseFinder and StashFinder found in this world.
liquidbounce.command.findings.unreadable: The findings saved for this world could not be read, see the client log.
liquidbounce.command.findings.list.descr: Lists the findings of this dimension.
liquidbounce.command.findings.waypoint.d: Saves a finding as a waypoint and selects it.
liquidbounce.command.waypoint.descriptio: Manages the waypoints of this world.
liquidbounce.command.waypoint.unreadable: The waypoints saved for this world could not be read, see the client log.
liquidbounce.command.waypoint.add.descri: Adds a waypoint where you stand or at the given coordinates.
liquidbounce.command.waypoint.add.coordi: Give all three coordinates or none.
liquidbounce.command.waypoint.add.reject: Up to %s waypoints with names of up to %s characters.
liquidbounce.command.waypoint.select.des: Marks a waypoint in the world.
liquidbounce.command.where.share.descrip: Tells the server chat where you are.
liquidbounce.module.baseFinder.descripti: Reports chunks with blocks and entities players leave behind.
liquidbounce.module.baseFinder.value.lan: Report a single block that never generates, like a beacon.
liquidbounce.module.baseFinder.value.wor: Workstations a chunk needs to be reported.
liquidbounce.module.baseFinder.value.ent: Placed entities a chunk needs to be reported.
liquidbounce.module.baseFinder.value.wri: Report signs with text on either side.
liquidbounce.module.baseFinder.value.dev: Report villagers that have traded enough to level up.
Possible base in the chunk at %s: %s.
liquidbounce.module.stashFinder.descript: Reports chunks with many containers and follows them as they change.
liquidbounce.module.stashFinder.value.mi: Containers a chunk needs to be reported.
liquidbounce.module.stashFinder.value.co: Blocks that count as containers; a double chest counts twice.
liquidbounce.module.stashFinder.value.ex: Ignore containers standing on these, like those of trial chambers.
liquidbounce.module.suspiciousBlockDetec: Reports blocks players place near you, like doors, chests and obsidian.
How far away a new block may be.
How long a freshly loaded chunk is ignored.
liquidbounce.module.collectibleESP.descr: Highlights valuables in item frames and banners.
liquidbounce.module.collectibleESP.value: Ignore tools, weapons and armor without enchantments.
liquidbounce.module.portalFinder.descrip: Reports and marks lit Nether and End portals.
liquidbounce.module.caveDisturbanceDetec: Marks plain air in cave walls, where someone mined.
liquidbounce.module.tunnelTrailESP.descr: Highlights dug tunnels, staircases and shafts.
liquidbounce.module.soundLocator.descrip: Marks where the server played selected sounds.
liquidbounce.module.soundLocator.value.c: Also report each sound in chat.
Jump always, only while moving, or only while sprinting.
liquidbounce.module.autoShearer.value.ra: How close a sheep has to be.
liquidbounce.module.autoShearer.value.an: Leave shears alone that are about to break.
liquidbounce.module.autoSign.description: Writes signs with the text of the last sign you wrote, or with templates.
liquidbounce.module.autoSign.value.textM: Repeat the last sign you wrote, or use the templates.
liquidbounce.module.autoSign.value.nearb: Open signs around you with an empty hand, so the side facing you gets written.
How close a sign has to be.
Also rewrite signs that already have text.
liquidbounce.module.autoAnvilRepair.desc: Combines damaged items of the same kind in an open anvil.
liquidbounce.module.autoAnvilRepair.valu: Most levels to spend on one repair.
liquidbounce.module.autoSmelter.descript: Keeps an open furnace, blast furnace or smoker going.
liquidbounce.module.autoSmelter.value.re: Fuel items to put in once the fire is out.
liquidbounce.module.autoBreed.descriptio: Feeds adult animals in reach that have a partner nearby.
liquidbounce.module.autoBreed.value.rang: How close an animal has to be.
liquidbounce.module.lightOverlay.descrip: Marks blocks where hostile mobs can spawn.
liquidbounce.module.lightOverlay.value.v: How far to check up and down.
liquidbounce.module.lightOverlay.value.l: Highest light level that still allows spawning.
liquidbounce.module.lightOverlay.value.c: Colour where mobs spawn right now.
liquidbounce.module.lightOverlay.value.p: Colour where mobs spawn once it is dark.
liquidbounce.module.waypoints.descriptio: Lists the waypoints of this world; manage them with .waypoint.
liquidbounce.module.messageAura.descript: Whispers a message to every player who comes into view.
liquidbounce.module.packetCanceller.valu: Packets never sent to the server.
Packets from the server that are never handled.
liquidbounce.module.intruderAlert.descri: Reports players who are not your friends as they come near.
liquidbounce.module.blastCover.descripti: Puts obsidian or glowstone between you and a charged anchor before it goes off.
liquidbounce.module.blastCover.value.mod: Rotate turns there silently, Crosshair waits until you look at a spot the cover goes to.
liquidbounce.module.blastCover.value.blo: Cover block to use first; the other one is the fallback.
liquidbounce.module.blastCover.value.tim: Put the cover up before the anchor is charged, or only before it goes off.
liquidbounce.module.blastCover.value.min: Cover only blasts that would hurt you at least this much.
liquidbounce.module.blastCover.value.max: Skip blasts that would hurt you more than this, cover or not.
liquidbounce.module.blastCover.value.lim: Most covers per anchor, 0 for no limit.
liquidbounce.module.blastCover.value.rea: How far away a cover may go.
liquidbounce.module.blastCover.value.tim: How long a detonation waits for its cover.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.descripti: Places, covers, charges and sets off respawn anchors next to targets.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.rea: How far away an anchor may go.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.min: Least damage the blast has to do to the target.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.max: Most damage the blast may do to you.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.ant: Never set off a blast that would kill you.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.cov: Put obsidian or glowstone between you and the anchor when the blast would hurt too much.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.onl: Never place anchors, only charge and set off ones already standing in reach.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.pla: Pause after placing an anchor or its cover, picked at random.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.cha: Pause after charging, picked at random.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.det: Pause after a blast, picked at random.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.gua: Ignore your own clicks on anchors while it works.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.col: Colour of the planned anchor and cover.
liquidbounce.module.anchorAura.value.pea: Wait with a charged anchor where an enemy ender pearl lands.
Colour of the landing spot and its flight time.
liquidbounce.module.anchorMacro.descript: While its bind is held, places an anchor where you look, charges it and sets it off.
liquidbounce.module.anchorMacro.value.sw: Switch slots only for the server, or like a number key; either way back right after.
liquidbounce.module.anchorMacro.value.on: Only set off anchors you placed.
liquidbounce.module.anchorMacro.value.an: Never set off a blast that would kill you.
liquidbounce.module.anchorMacro.value.re: How far away an anchor may go.
liquidbounce.module.anchorMacro.value.de: Pause after each step, picked at random.
liquidbounce.module.anchorMacro.value.gu: Ignore your own clicks on anchors while it works.
liquidbounce.module.anchorMacro.value.do: Right after the blast, place and charge a second anchor in the same spot.
Set the second one off once the target's hurt time is down to this.
How long the second anchor waits at most.
liquidbounce.module.swingRedirect.descri: Turns a swing at the air onto the closest target near the crosshair.
How close a target has to be.
How far left or right of the crosshair a target may be.
How far above or below the crosshair a target may be.
Body heights to aim at; the one closest to the crosshair wins.
Also redirect clicks at a block.
Mark the spot a missed swing would hit.
Keep the server-side rotation on the target the whole time, not only for the swing.
liquidbounce.module.hitHold.description: Holds a swing at a target that cannot take it yet and lands it as soon as it can.
liquidbounce.module.hitHold.value.hurt.d: Wait while the target is still hurt from the last hit.
liquidbounce.module.hitHold.value.airbor: Wait while the target is in the air.
liquidbounce.module.hitFlick.description: Turns away for a tick before each hit, then back onto the target.
liquidbounce.module.hitFlick.value.requi: Only flick hits made while sprinting.
liquidbounce.module.hitFlick.value.jitte: Random offset added to the turn away and to the turn back.
liquidbounce.module.crossbowLoader.descr: Loads a crossbow from the hotbar or inventory, then switches itself off.
liquidbounce.module.crossbowLoader.value: Hold the loaded crossbow so the next click fires it; back to the old slot after the shot.
liquidbounce.module.crossbowLoader.messa: There is no unloaded crossbow in your inventory.
There is nothing to load the crossbow with.
liquidbounce.module.shieldSwap.descripti: Blocks with a shield from the hotbar or inventory while enabled, best on a key.
There is no shield in your inventory.
liquidbounce.module.shieldGuard.descript: Raises a shield when a close enemy can swing or runs at you.
liquidbounce.module.shieldGuard.value.re: How close an enemy can hit you from.
liquidbounce.module.shieldGuard.value.co: Block when an enemy in reach can swing again.
liquidbounce.module.shieldGuard.value.ru: Block when an enemy runs at you.
How fast an enemy has to come at you to count as running.
liquidbounce.module.shieldGuard.value.cr: Lower the shield while falling onto a target, for a critical hit.
liquidbounce.module.shieldGuard.value.sw: Hold a sword while the shield is disabled.
liquidbounce.module.shieldGuard.value.ri: Block an enemy in reach on the way up of a jump, where no hit of yours could be critical.
liquidbounce.module.shieldGuard.value.we: Ignore enemies holding no sword, axe or mace.
liquidbounce.module.shieldGuard.value.lo: Keep the shield down against an enemy holding an axe, which would disable it.
liquidbounce.module.shieldGuard.value.ho: Send no attacks while the shield is up.
liquidbounce.module.crystalMacro.descrip: Places obsidian where you look if it needs to, then a crystal on it, and blows the crystal up.
liquidbounce.module.crystalMacro.value.k: Press it to crystal the block you look at.
liquidbounce.module.crystalMacro.value.o: Also crystal after you hit an enemy with a sword.
liquidbounce.module.crystalMacro.value.b: Hit the crystal once, twice, or until it is gone.
liquidbounce.module.crystalMacro.value.h: Hold the hit until the nearest enemy can take damage again.
liquidbounce.module.crystalMacro.value.g: Do nothing while you are in the air.
liquidbounce.module.crystalMacro.value.l: After an enemy dies, leave its armor, totems, apples and crystals alone this long. 0 never waits.
liquidbounce.module.crystalMacro.value.s: How long the crystal or obsidian stays selected after a click.
liquidbounce.module.crystalMacro.value.r: How to aim at the block and the crystal.
liquidbounce.module.bucketSteal.descript: Scoops water and lava next to your enemy with an empty bucket, or plugs it with a cobweb.
liquidbounce.module.bucketSteal.value.ra: How close to the enemy a source has to be.
liquidbounce.module.bucketSteal.value.en: How close an enemy has to be.
liquidbounce.module.bucketSteal.value.co: Plug the source with a cobweb when you have no empty bucket.
liquidbounce.module.bucketSteal.value.on: Only take sources next to a cobweb.
liquidbounce.module.bucketSteal.value.de: Pause after each source, picked at random.
liquidbounce.module.bucketSteal.value.sl: How long the bucket or cobweb stays selected after a click.
liquidbounce.module.bucketSteal.value.ro: Aim on your own, or with None only take what your crosshair is on.
liquidbounce.module.misplayGuard.descrip: Drops clicks of yours that lose fights.
liquidbounce.module.misplayGuard.value.c: No glowstone into an anchor that is already charged.
liquidbounce.module.misplayGuard.value.s: No glowstone on anything but an anchor.
liquidbounce.module.misplayGuard.value.e: No opening an ender chest while you hold a combat item.
liquidbounce.module.misplayGuard.value.c: Items that keep the ender chest shut.
liquidbounce.module.misplayGuard.value.g: No firework from the ground, unless a crossbow is in your offhand.
liquidbounce.module.misplayGuard.value.s: No sword hits on a player whose shield is up.
liquidbounce.module.totemSwitch.descript: Holds a hotbar totem while the next hit could kill you, then gives your slot back.
liquidbounce.module.totemSwitch.value.ma: Health to keep on top of the worst hit.
liquidbounce.module.totemSwitch.value.ra: How far around you explosions count.
liquidbounce.module.totemSwitch.value.an: Count charged respawn anchors where they explode.
liquidbounce.module.totemSwitch.value.pl: Count obsidian and bedrock an enemy could put a crystal on.
liquidbounce.module.totemSwitch.value.ma: Count enemies falling on you with a mace.
liquidbounce.module.totemSwitch.value.sw: Count sword hits while your health is low.
liquidbounce.module.totemSwitch.value.lo: Health from which sword hits count.
liquidbounce.module.totemSwitch.value.pe: Hold the totem while your own ender pearl is in the air.
liquidbounce.module.totemSwitch.value.re: How long it has to be safe before your slot comes back.
liquidbounce.module.antiTrap.description: Keeps bait entities near you out of your world and refuses sign editors you did not open.
liquidbounce.module.antiTrap.value.range: How near an entity has to be to be kept out.
liquidbounce.module.antiTrap.value.minec: Keep out minecarts of every kind.
liquidbounce.module.antiTrap.value.itemF: Keep out item frames and glow item frames.
liquidbounce.module.antiTrap.value.boats: Keep out boats and rafts, with or without a chest.
liquidbounce.module.antiTrap.value.remov: Also remove the ones already there.
liquidbounce.module.antiTrap.value.refus: Refuse a sign editor the server opens without you placing or clicking that sign, and close one already open.
liquidbounce.module.antiTrap.messages.re: Refused the sign editor the server opened at %s.
liquidbounce.module.antiTrap.messages.cl: Closed the sign editor at %s you did not open.
liquidbounce.module.disguise.description: Shows the nearest player who is not your friend under another name and skin.
Tag after the name, left out when empty.
Tier shown in front of the name above their head, left out when off.
liquidbounce.module.disguise.value.gamem: Kit whose icon comes before the tier.
liquidbounce.module.noItemBounce.descrip: Stops hotbar items from bouncing when they change.
liquidbounce.module.oreSimulation.descri: Predicts the ores of the loaded chunks from the world seed.
Seed of the world. Singleplayer worlds use their own.
How many chunks around you to predict.
liquidbounce.module.oreSimulation.messag: Type the world seed into Seed, the server does not tell it.
liquidbounce.module.cartBomb.description: Lays a rail with TNT minecarts where you look and shoots them, or where your flaming arrow comes down.
liquidbounce.module.cartBomb.value.key.d: Press to lay the carts on the block you look at.
liquidbounce.module.cartBomb.value.onSho: Lay the carts where your own flaming arrow is going to land.
Least flight time an arrow needs for the carts to be down before it lands.
liquidbounce.module.cartBomb.value.carts: TNT minecarts to stack on the rail.
liquidbounce.module.cartBomb.value.ignit: Shoot the carts once they are down: with a Flame bow, or through fire you light first.
liquidbounce.module.cartBomb.value.charg: How long to draw the bow.
liquidbounce.module.cartBomb.value.switc: Hold your bow or crossbow again afterwards.
liquidbounce.module.cartBomb.value.safeB: Put a block next to your feet on the cart's side before shooting.
liquidbounce.module.cartBomb.value.hitPl: While you draw a bow, aim at a TNT minecart already lying next to an enemy and let go.
How far away the cart may be.
How close to an enemy the cart has to be.
liquidbounce.module.cartBomb.value.overl: A second key that stacks several carts on the rail in one go before shooting them.
Press to overload the block you look at.
Only use carts from the hotbar instead of taking more from the inventory.
liquidbounce.module.pearlCart.descriptio: Lays a TNT minecart where an enemy's ender pearl comes down and shoots it as they arrive.
liquidbounce.module.pearlCart.value.rang: How close to you the pearl has to land.
liquidbounce.module.pearlCart.value.cart: TNT minecarts to stack on the rail.
liquidbounce.module.pearlCart.value.dela: How long after the arrival the arrow should hit.
liquidbounce.module.pearlCart.value.minE: Least damage the blast has to deal to the thrower where they arrive.
liquidbounce.module.pearlCart.value.maxS: Most damage the blast may deal to you.
liquidbounce.module.cartBreaker.descript: Breaks unlit TNT minecarts others put down near you; yours stay.
liquidbounce.module.cartBreaker.value.ra: How close a cart has to be.
liquidbounce.module.cartBreaker.value.fO: How far off your view a cart may be.
liquidbounce.module.cartBreaker.value.sw: Hit with a sword from the hotbar.
liquidbounce.module.cartCover.descriptio: Places blocks between you and a lit TNT minecart until it can no longer hurt you much.
liquidbounce.module.cartCover.value.trig: Predicted damage from which to start covering.
liquidbounce.module.cartCover.value.safe: Keep placing until the prediction is below this.
liquidbounce.module.cartCover.value.unli: Also cover against carts that are not lit yet, except your own.
liquidbounce.module.cartCover.value.prot: Whose carts to cover against: your own, others' or both.
liquidbounce.module.cartCover.value.maxB: Most blocks to place against one cart.
liquidbounce.module.breachSwap.descripti: Now and then swings your Breach mace instead of your sword.
liquidbounce.module.breachSwap.value.cha: How many sword hits become mace hits.
liquidbounce.module.shieldDrain.descript: Hits an enemy who holds up a shield several times a tick.
liquidbounce.module.shieldDrain.value.ra: How close the enemy has to be.
liquidbounce.module.shieldDrain.value.ma: Hit with a mace from the hotbar.
liquidbounce.module.shieldDrain.value.mi: Only drain once you have fallen this far.
liquidbounce.module.shieldDrain.value.pa: Only drain while you are in the air.
liquidbounce.module.shieldDrain.value.cr: Only drain the enemy under your crosshair.
